build_scicite_dataset: build a scicite dataset using tfds.builder_cls('scicite') to load citation context classification data
create_scicite_builder: create a Scicite dataset builder instance via LazyBuilderImport('scicite') for citation classification
test_scicite_as_dataset: test the scicite builder by calling as_dataset() to retrieve the citation classification dataset
run_scicite_download_prepare: run download_and_prepare() on the scicite builder to download and prepare the dataset
review_scicite_info: review the scicite builder info property to inspect dataset features splits and citation classification metadata
